name: email-campaign
description: Fixed six-call, read-only email-campaign preparation pipeline. Discovers 10 companies by industry and 50-500 employee size, retrieves domain-level email patterns, finds and verifies one known target's work email, enriches that person, and adds company firmographics. Requires a complete, internally consistent target. It does not draft or send email. All calls settle through the SELAT Router over MPP on Tempo.

industry.description: Fiber industry filter, e.g. Software. Use a supported Fiber industry value.

domain.description: Bare target company domain matching company and email, e.g. stripe.com.

firstName.description: Target person's first name, matching email.

lastName.description: Target person's last name, matching email.

company.description: Target company name matching domain and email.

email.description: Known target work email to verify. The verifier checks technical deliverability, not consent or legal permission to contact.

steps.label: discover 10 companies by industry and size — Fiber (MPP on Tempo)
emails by domain — Hunter (MPP on Tempo)
find target work email — Hunter (MPP on Tempo)
verify supplied work email — Hunter (MPP on Tempo)
enrich target lead — Apollo (MPP on Tempo)
